comment: never repeats anything and gives hard work

Infectious Diseases is a great gen-ed filler class. Easy, fun, interesting-- Dr. Lessem makes it enjoyable for a class full of non-majors. She doesn't want to make it hard, and really doesn't. Definitely recommend her and the class.

Dr. Lessem's class was really chill. She worked us hard, but was extremely fair in grading and expectations. Class participation was a big deal, but the class had such a chill environment that speaking up was no big deal.

Dr. Paula Lessem is what college professors should be.  Tough, but fair.  She is passionate about teaching, and is willing to help you if you put forth the effort.  Worked hard in her class, but loved her committment.
expects you to participate. on her papers she loves organization and paragraphs.  If you show interest and participate, you should be able to do well

She was my professor for Science Meets Fiction. She expects a lot of you during discussions that occur every class and you read a book every week. While the class and her were interesting, the work load was high.

Absolutely Love Lessem. She's so nice and helpful. The class is very interesting and as long as you actually read the books and do your work you will be fine. Also, speak up during class. It's part of your grade and she will appreciate you more for it. Wish I could take her again. Most books were very good but not all were.

She is a really nice person outside of class. In-class, her grading standards are inconsistent and she favors some students over others. The class is interesting but she makes it IMPOSSIBLE to get an A. Not a whole lot of work but she is a very picky grader. At times, she might be kind of rude. Interesting class, but not a great teacher overall.
Dr. Lessem is AWESOME!  Extremely compassionate and helpful.  You put forth the efort, and she will get you through.

She is a tough cookie. She was always really helpful, although you never knew what you were going to get on your lab assignments. She has online quizzes that are pretty easy if you just read the lab. She really wants her students to come out of lab understanding what was just done. Would reccommend!!!

She was a Thesis committee member of mine. I loved this lady! She is helpful, extremely competent, and totally committed to helping students succeed.  You can count on her word, and her work ethic is incredible! I owe her a huge debt of gratitude!
wonderful teacher!!! very helpful and kind. Always trying to help her students.

Took her for Mayterm; BIGGEST MISTAKE of MY LIFE! NEVER take this class during Mayterm! It was suppose to be an entry level course for science majors to fulfill their Science requirement and this was more like a 300 level course than a 100 level!She is helpful and claimed she wanted to see us succeed, however, her tests and that was bs!

Taking lab with her was the first time I ever really understood what I was doing and why I was doing it in lab. I absolutely loved her. She was funny, helpful, and  always willing to stop and explain things. She's available during office hours and will skim through your lab and give you feedback before it's due if you ask her to. GREAT prof.

So far I have loved Dr. Lessem in lab. She knows her stuff and always makes sure you are understanding before she moves on. She talks a little fast but is more than willing and helpful if you go see her outside of class. I definately recommend taking her.
i took an 815 just to be in her lab. shes soo nice and helpful.
I love her! she is always there for extra help. she wants you to do well. plus she like student athletes. great for me
enjoys being petty, not really sure how she runs the bio labs when she is one of the most nit picky and least helpful professor
she's knows her stuff
Dr. Lessem is a very dedicated teacher. she was very precise and clear and was always there for extra help outside of class.  I loved her for bio lab
I thought she is the most helpful science teacher I've ever had, she really cares about her students and helps alot
Made genetics lab harder than organic lab.  She has the amazing ability to turn the simplest experiments/assignments into a confusing and painful ordeal.
Way to nit-picky with grading.  Great at instructing but her terrible at grading and explaining what she wants you to turn in atleast.  Anal-retentive a little!

She tries to come across as the nicest person in the world but in reality she looks for ways to give bad grades. I did fine in lecture, but terrible in lab. I scheduled my lab for next semester at 2 until 5 on a Friday just so I didnt have to take her for the instructor.
great teacher.

Never explains what she expects on lab reports.  Grades very hard compared to the other lab teachers.  I loved genetics lecture, but will never take science again because of plessem's lab.  Stay away!

She has very strict standards for what she expects of your work, and doesn't to much to make the lab very exciting.  And if you have a morning lab with her, she really does not take well to tired students:  BE WARNED!
Wonderful lab instructor. Fair grader. Tells you what you need to get an A.
One of the best labs I have had.  She can break down the concepts and will go out of her way to make sure you understand.  Great professor.
loved her. hate genetics, but she made it bearable.
Terrible absolutely Terrible
Awesome teacher. Helpful outside of class and was able to help students understand the material well
